title: 第十五章 干涉现实血手印第十六章 恐惧幻象
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
“啊~？”
张威身后两人，在听到他的讲述之后，不由得面面相觑。
C级的诡异都这样了，那更强的B级和A级呢？
想到那种强大的诡异，两人不由便是情不自禁的打了个寒颤。
不过还好，他们这次的任务目标，只是一只E级或是D级的诡异而已，还在他们的处理范围之内。
不由的，两人皆是暗暗的松了口气。
虽然说，他们在作出选择的时候，便已经做好了殉职的准备。
但是能活着谁又愿意死呢？
能够循序渐进的增加任务难度，给他们一个熟悉变强的过程，他们自然也不想第一次任务，便就摊上必死的任务。
来到事发现场单元门，张威三人凝重的看向其中，黑洞洞的单元门，仿佛吞噬一切的深渊。
不要看张威说的轻松，这可是他处理的第一起诡异事件，他还是很慎重的，甚至说是紧张之中，带着一点点恐惧。
“呼~！”
张威暗自做了个深呼吸，方才是沉声说道：
“走吧！”
话音落下，张威便是率先进入了单元楼道。
“啪！”
伴随着重重的脚步落地之声，楼道的声控灯瞬间亮起。
张威的这一操作，立即便是吓了身后两人一跳。
“队长，这样不会引起诡异的注意吗？”
看着瞬间明亮起来的楼道，张威的那两个下属，不由便是出声询问。

“呵呵，只要我们距离诡异一段距离，那诡异自然便能发现我们的踪迹。
隐不隐藏行迹，并没有多大的用处，除非能够达到B级，演化出属于自己的领域，这才能够收敛自身的所有气机，不会被其他的诡异发现。
而且，这还是要不能与其他诡异领域接触的情况。
更何况，你们是不是忘了。
那诡异营造的幻象，再有阳光光明的地方，才更容易发现破绽。
如果我们一直处在黑暗之中，还真有可能着了道，被困在这里呢，然后就只能等到天亮，这才能够脱困了。”
“哦！”
两人闻言，不由的连连点头，纷纷露出恍然之色。
而跟在三人身后的陆羽，在听到张威的解释之后，不由微微一愣。
「B级才会拥有领域吗？可是...」
陆羽虽然只能在现实之中，形成一些简单的幻象，但是在梦境之中，他可是已经拥有了领域的，也确实能够屏蔽诡异（梦魔）对他的感知。
但是，按他自己的感觉，他现在也才不过E级而已。
不过很快，陆羽便是反应过来，这大概便于他现在，便可以在现实凝聚幻象一样，应该都是因为他的梦境世界的原因。
想明白这点之后，陆羽便是不再纠结，而是快步走向了那一个敞开的单元门。
刚一接近，陆羽便就感觉到了，一丝丝的阴冷气息扑面而来，欲要侵入他的体内，勾动其心中的恐惧。
不过，那一丝丝的阴冷气息，侵入陆羽体内的瞬间，便已经被其体内的力量吞噬，没有泛起半点的涟漪。
content_en:
"Ah~?"
The two people behind Zhang Wei couldn't help but look at each other in shock after hearing his story.
The C-level weirdness is like this, what about the stronger B-level and A-level?
Thinking of that powerful weirdness, the two of them couldn't help but shudder.
Fortunately, the target of their mission this time was just an E-level or D-level weirdo, which was still within their processing range.
Involuntarily, both of them secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Although it is said that when they made their choice, they were already prepared to die in the line of duty.
But who wants to die if he can live?
It can gradually increase the difficulty of the task and give them a process of getting familiar with it and becoming stronger. Naturally, they don't want to face a fatal task on their first mission.
Arriving at the unit door where the incident occurred, Zhang Wei and the other three looked solemnly inside. The dark unit door seemed like an abyss swallowing everything.
Although Zhang Wei said it was easy, this was the first strange incident he had dealt with, and he was still very cautious, even nervous, with a little fear.
"Huh~!"
Zhang Wei secretly took a deep breath and then said in a deep voice:
"Let's go!"
After the words fell, Zhang Wei was the first to enter the corridor of the unit.
"Crack!"
With the sound of heavy footsteps hitting the ground, the voice-activated lights in the corridor instantly turned on.
Zhang Wei's operation immediately startled the two people behind him.
"Captain, won't this attract strange attention?"
Looking at the corridor that suddenly became brighter, Zhang Wei's two subordinates couldn't help but ask.
"Haha, as long as we are a certain distance away from Weirdness, Weirdness will naturally be able to find our traces.
Hiding one's tracks or not is not of much use unless one can reach B level and evolve into his own domain. Only then can he be able to contain all his energy and not be discovered by other weird things.
Moreover, this is still the case if there is no contact with other weird fields.
What's more, have you forgotten?
In that strangely created illusion, it is easier to find flaws in a sunny place.
If we have been in darkness, we might actually get caught and be trapped here, and then we would have to wait until daybreak before we can escape. "
"Oh!"
Hearing this, the two of them couldn't help but nod their heads, and both showed expressions of astonishment.
Lu Yu, who was following the three of them, couldn't help but be slightly startled after hearing Zhang Wei's explanation.
"Does only B-class have fields? But..."
Although Lu Yu can only form some simple illusions in reality, in dreams, he already has a domain and can indeed block the weird (dream demon) perception of him.
However, according to his own feeling, he is only E-level now.
But soon, Lu Yu realized that it was probably because of his dream world that he could now condense illusions in reality.
After understanding this, Lu Yu stopped worrying and quickly walked towards the open door of the unit.
As soon as he got close, Lu Yu felt a trace of cold breath coming towards his face, trying to invade his body and stir up the fear in his heart.
However, the moment the trace of cold breath invaded Lu Yu's body, it was already swallowed up by the power in his body without causing any ripples.
